headline: Eagles Trade Cam Jurgens To Ravens
summary: The Eagles shockingly lost future Hall of Fame right tackle Lane Johnson to retirement on Tuesday. A day later, another of the Eagles’ offensive line stalwarts is exiting. The Eagles are trading center Cam Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick to the Ravens for a 2028 second-round selection and a 2027 fifth-rounder, Adam Schefter of […]

headline: Texans HC DeMeco Ryans Reclaims Defensive Play-Calling Duties
summary: Sitting at 0-4, the Texans are not making a coaching change. A shift in responsibilities will be taking place along the sidelines, however. Head coach DeMeco Ryans announced on Wednesday that he is taking over defensive play-calling responsibilities. headline: Jayden Daniels On Track To Return In Week 5; Marcus Mariota Sprains MCL

headline: Buccaneers S Antoine Winfield To Miss Time
summary: Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield is expected to miss two to four weeks with a rib fracture, head coach Todd Bowles said on Monday (via senior team writer Scott Smith). headline: Broncos' Payton: Concerned about details, not playcalling
summary: Sean Payton said righting the wrongs of Denver's offense is more about the "specific and the detail of each play," not who is actually calling the plays.
